title: Dropbox, Inc. $DBX Stock: Crossmark Global Holdings Inc. Reduces Stake
ai_summary: Crossmark Global Holdings reduced its Dropbox stake by 10.7% in Q3, selling 32,883 shares and holding 275,216 shares worth $9.3 million. Other institutions like Pacer Advisors and Wedge Capital increased positions, while Dropbox reported Q3 EPS of $0.75, beating estimates. Analysts rate the stock 'Reduce' with a $29.75 price target.

title: AI Transforms Work: Report Reveals Time Loss and Content Explosion
ai_summary: A Dropbox report surveyed 219 professionals and found they spend 15.8 hours weekly on AI, with 36.6% of that time retrieving context. Reducing context retrieval by half could save $577,000 annually for a 100-employee small business. The report also notes 46.4% of new work files involve AI input.

title: Meet Dennis Woodside, who began his career as M&A lawyer in 1990s; decades later, he became CEO of Freshworks after leadership roles at Google and Dropbox
ai_summary: Dennis Woodside, who began as an M&A lawyer in the 1990s, became CEO of Freshworks in May 2024 after leading operations at Impossible Foods and serving as president of Freshworks. He previously held leadership roles at Google, Motorola Mobility, and Dropbox, and joined Freshworks in September 2022.

title: Dropbox chief accounting officer Sarah Schubach sells $73,228 in stock
ai_summary: Sarah Schubach, Dropbox's chief accounting officer, sold 1,991 shares on September 15, 2026, at $36.78 per share, totaling $73,228. The sale was executed under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted in June 2026. Dropbox stock trades near its 52-week high, and the company reported Q2 2026 earnings of $0.75 per share.

title: 5 Top Work From Home Operations Jobs You Can Apply for Today
ai_summary: Remote operations jobs are highlighted, including roles like Remote Operations Manager and Senior Analyst in Corporate FP&A. Salaries range from $103K to $361.4K annually, with over 2,726 positions available. Companies like Dropbox, Twilio, and Reddit are hiring.

title: The AI productivity boom has bosses asking what’s in it for employees
ai_summary: Leaders at PepsiCo, Indeed, Dropbox, and Bristol Myers Squibb are rethinking how AI productivity gains benefit employees. Indeed reports engineers write 50% more code and save six hours weekly, while Dropbox and Bristol Myers Squibb explore cognitive health and well-being quotients. The companies are weighing how to split productivity gains between business and workforce.

title: What Dropbox Holders Bought Into
ai_summary: Dropbox's Q2 2026 revenue rose to $631.5m from $625.7m, but net margin fell to 15.2% from 20.1%. Analysts debate whether AI tools can sustain growth, with fair values ranging from $23 to $32. The stock trades at $36.54, above the lower fair value.

title: Dropbox co-CEO Andrew Houston sells $1.04m in stock
ai_summary: Andrew Houston, Dropbox co-CEO, sold 29,500 shares on October 12, 2026, for $1,035,234, averaging $35.09 per share. The sale follows Dropbox's Q2 earnings beat and a data breach affecting about 5,000 accounts. Analysts remain divided, with William Blair upgrading and BofA raising its price target.

title: EchoFile Introduces Pilot Program for Seamless Cloud-to-Cloud File Sharing ...Middle East
ai_summary: EchoFile announced a pilot program to test its cloud-to-cloud file connector for sharing files between Google Drive, Dropbox, and Microsoft SharePoint. The program aims to simplify cross-platform file sharing for organizations.

title: Why the Market Dipped But Dropbox (DBX) Gained Today
ai_summary: Dropbox shares rose 2.09% to $35.60, outpacing the S&P 500's 0.02% loss. The company is expected to report EPS of $0.73 and revenue of $628.6 million, both down year-over-year. Analysts have not changed estimates, and Dropbox holds a Zacks Rank of #3.

title: Dropbox Empowers Muse Connector to Streamline Project Onboarding
ai_summary: Dropbox integrated with Meta Muse to streamline project onboarding, allowing users to pull Dropbox documents into workflows. The integration also generates content from stored materials and tracks deliverables. It is available to English users in the US and Canada across all Muse plans.

title: I tried to break Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Syncthing on purpose
ai_summary: The author tested Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Syncthing by editing, renaming, and deleting files offline on two PCs. Dropbox and OneDrive preserved both versions, while Syncthing's conflict handling depended on versioning settings. The conclusion is that syncing is not backing up, and conflicts can occur without errors.

title: Dropbox (NASDAQ:DBX) Upgraded at Zacks Research
ai_summary: Zacks Research upgraded Dropbox from a strong sell to a hold rating. The stock opened at $33.08, with a consensus target of $29.75 and an average rating of Reduce. Analysts expect 1.94 EPS for the current fiscal year.

title: Linear MCP, Notion, Dropbox Dash Cracked in ClawSecure Test
ai_summary: ClawSecure cracked Linear, Notion, and Dropbox Dash MCP platforms, finding critical default vulnerabilities in the MCP protocol itself. The report, released September 24, 2026, shows the same attack class across clean implementations, with Linear's live production system exploited in 75 minutes.
